business.description: The Company did not carry out any business activities during the year under review and does not foresee any immediate prospects of commencing business operations in the near future.

outlook.statement: The management does not foresee any immediate prospects of commencing business operations in the near future, pending improvement in the financial position of the Company.

The Company is in the process of appointing another suitable Independent Director in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Act and the Listing Regulations. The Company is making continuous efforts to identify a suitable candidate possessing the requisite qualifications, experience, expertise and independence. The appointment shall be made at the earliest, subject to the availability and consent of a suitable candidate and completion of the requisite corporate and regulatory formalities.

The Indian economy is driven by the government with its Make in India slogan and bold initiatives for overall socio economic development towards continued growth prospectus. Your company is well poised to reap the benefits in all the sectors. The outlook of the management in all the sectors is positive despite variety of adversity of factors.
The Company is planning to take various measures in terms of arranging resources to gain more time for the business to recover.

risks: difficulty in attracting suitable Independent Director candidates

Limited business operations and present financial position with accumulated losses and absence of active business activities causing practical difficulties in attracting suitable Independent Director candidates

Qualified opinion in Statutory Auditors' Report relating to accumulated interest amount of Rs. 17,156.31 lakhs computed from 1997 onwards at 18% per annum compounded quarterly on a principal of approximately Rs. 70 lakhs
Secretarial Auditor observation regarding composition of Board of Directors and committees including appointment of Independent Director
Financial instability marked by persistent losses and liquidity issues
Lack of business activity leading to underutilized assets and diminished market presence
Difficulty in securing new funding due to financial history with high borrowing costs
Regulatory compliance and accurate financial reporting critical to avoid legal complications
Reputation and competitive position suffered, making it difficult to attract new business or re-enter market
Broader economic downturns and evolving industry conditions threatening recovery prospects

The Company's net worth has been completely eroded and its ability to continue as a going concern basis inspite of the present accumulated losses is dependent upon the infusion of funds for its operations.

There is interest liability of Rs. 3,328.91 lakhs (Rs. 2,791.50 lakhs) and also cumulative interest liability upto March 31, 2026 amounting to Rs. 20,485.22 lakhs (Rs. 17,156.31 lakhs) on the outstanding amount payable to Alchemist Asset Reconstruction Company Limited as trustee for the Alchemist XXXVI Trust for which no provision is made in the books of account from 1997 till date.
The loss for the year is understated by Rs.3,341.46 lakhs (Rs.2,804.04 lakhs) and net worth for the year is overstated by Rs.20,497.77 lakhs (Rs. 17,168.85 lakhs).
No confirmations or any documents are available to verify the amount outstanding as at the balance sheet date and hence are taken subject to confirmation and reconciliation.
The amounts are lying in the Current Accounts with Canara Bank for more than twelve months and are subject to confirmation.

litigation: Debt Recovery Tribunal proceedings regarding Canara Bank loan assigned to Green Malabar Finance Ventures Ltd, Capri Global Capital Ltd, and Alchemist Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd

The Hon'ble Mumbai Debts Recovery Tribunal No. 1 vide its order in O.A. No. 1768 of 2000 determined a sum of Rs. 135.07 lakhs inclusive of principal and interest as due from the Company and directed the Company to pay the said dues along with future interest @18% p.a. with quarterly rests from September 10, 1997 till realisation.

Canara Bank assigned the debt to Green Malabar Finance Ventures Limited (Assignment Agreement dated September 29, 2017). The Tribunal vide order dated May 18, 2018 held that Green Malabar Finance Ventures Limited was neither a bank nor a Financial Institution under SARFAESI Act/RDB Act and directed them to approach appropriate forum.

Green Malabar Finance Ventures Limited assigned the debt to Capri Global Capital Limited (July 27, 2018), who assigned it to Alchemist Asset Reconstruction Company Limited as trustee for Alchemist XXXVI Trust (August 6, 2018). The Tribunal vide order dated March 8, 2019 held it has jurisdiction to continue proceedings.
